action.newText: [cli] When a memory create, list or search API call fails with an API or network error other than HTTP 401/403, the command prints the error to stderr and exits 1. HTTP 401/403 print the error to stderr and retain exit 2 through the shared handleApiError mapping.

rationale: This removes the contradiction with both the spec and AC-7 without changing the specified behavior for other API/network failures.

The complete branch review reports no open findings, and all reported local gates passed. Spot-checks of ownership, transactional replacement, locked retirement, search authorization and export pagination found no concrete blocker.
